notes.title: Speed Rivals – Version 0.5.0a Patch Notes
notes.content:
Speed Rivals — Patch Notes & Version History
Last Updated: August 13, 2025

Here’s what’s new in Version 0.5.0a:

• 29‑Language Support – Full localization to reach a global audience.
• Save System Fix – Resolved a critical issue preventing players on older versions from loading and playing normally.
• Pre‑Race Settings – You can now adjust camera view, radio station, and other settings before races begin.
• “I Robot” Achievement Fixed – The bug that blocked completion of this achievement has been resolved.
• Main Menu Visual Upgrade – Improved road model for a polished menu appearance.
• General Polish – Minor bug fixes and smoother race flow overall.

Demo Updates – Early August 2025:
• New Control Styles – Added single‑trigger options to mimic classic slot‑car behavior:
– Release = full stop
– Release = gradual slow down
Two‑button controls remain available for precision runners.
• On‑Board / First‑Person Camera – Introduced an immersive first‑person driving view.
• UI & Garage Tweaks – Enhanced interface and smoother interaction during setup and vehicle selection.

We’ll keep this post updated with each new version. For questions or feedback, please create a separate discussion thread in the Community Hub.

— The Speed Rivals Team

notes.title: 🚀 New Update: Jarama Track, Progression System & 30 Achievements!
notes.content:
Big update time! 🚗💨

We’ve just updated the Speed Rivals Demo with a bunch of new content and surprises:

✅ Full progression system: Unlock all circuits and cars as you race!  
✅ New surprise track: The legendary Jarama Circuit joins the lineup 🏁  
✅ 30 Steam Achievements to chase and complete 🏆  
✅ Leaderboards updated for each track – your previous lap times are still saved even if circuits are temporarily locked.

Whether you're a returning player or new to the rails, it's the perfect time to jump back in and see if you can master the tracks!

🕹️ Play the updated demo now:  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3389390/Speed_Rivals/

notes.title: 🎮 Speed Rivals Demo – Now Available!
notes.content:
The wait is over!
You can now play the Speed Rivals demo for FREE – a fast-paced slot car racing game that mixes Scalextric nostalgia with modern arcade action. 🚗💨

What’s inside the demo?

 4 unique tracks designed to test your reflexes.
 30+ cars with different styles and handling.
 Simple controls (accelerate/brake), tough to master.
 Cartoon-style cars on realistic track environments.
 Pure speed and chaotic fun!


What are you waiting for?
Download now, push your skills to the limit, fly off the track (if you dare!), and share your feedback to help us make Speed Rivals the ultimate slot racing experience.

➡️ Play the Demo on Steam
